profile_text.body:
Thinking Machines Lab is an artificial intelligence research and product company, according to its own site. It is a for-profit startup founded in 2025 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. The company describes its goal as building a future where everyone has access to the knowledge and tools to make AI work for their own needs and goals. It says that while AI capabilities have advanced, the scientific community's understanding of frontier systems lags behind those capabilities, that knowledge of how such systems are trained is concentrated within top research labs, and that the systems remain difficult for people to customize.

The company says it is building AI systems that are more widely understood, customizable, and generally capable. It states an emphasis on human-AI collaboration through multimodal systems rather than fully autonomous ones, on adaptable and personalized systems that extend beyond programming and mathematics, and on frontier model intelligence in domains such as science and programming. On safety, it describes an empirical and iterative approach combining proactive research with real-world testing, including red-teaming and post-deployment monitoring, and says it plans to publish technical blog posts, papers, and code. The site says its team includes scientists, engineers, and builders who have worked on products and projects including ChatGPT, Character.ai, open-weights models like Mistral, PyTorch, OpenAI Gym, Fairseq, and Segment Anything.

The record holds no tracked products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits for the company. California is the jurisdiction listed for its legal exposure.
